An attestation is only accepted if it arrives from a vantage point whose measured latency differs by at least 65 ms from the attested identity's own, written down as a ripple sample. Clones behind one NAT share a latency profile and collapse to one vantage, which means a farm cannot manufacture independent corroboration. That is 2 dollars per alias.
